message: <iframe> removed: mail clients don't load embedded documents or plugins
hint: Mail clients don't load embedded pages or plugins. Link to the page instead, e.g. with a screenshot of it as the link's image.

message: <input> removed: mail clients disable or strip form controls
hint: Mail clients disable or strip form controls. Link to a form on the web instead; an <a> with data-email="button" makes a button every client shows.
A hidden input only feeds a form submit, which mail clients don't do.

message: <button> removed: mail clients disable or strip form controls
hint: Mail clients disable or strip form controls. Link to a form on the web instead; an <a> with data-email="button" makes a button every client shows.

message: <form> removed, its content kept: mail clients disable or strip forms
hint: Mail clients disable or strip form controls. Link to a form on the web instead; an <a> with data-email="button" makes a button every client shows.
